subject: Approval request: publicity-for-discount — limited-exclusivity ask from Stratos
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Ava Roberts <ava@stratosanalytics.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Publicity in exchange for concession — ask for exec sign-off

Ava / team — thanks for the productive demo earlier. Stratos is keen to move forward but procurement flagged public-reference requirements as a justification for the requested commercial concession. Summary of the ask from Stratos: 20% one-year discount + $35k credit in exchange for a co-branded case study, logo use on our site, and a joint press mention. They also asked for a 9-month "limited exclusivity" clause (narrowly scoped).

We can meet the commercial side but limited exclusivity + logo commitments are outside standard deal desk guardrails. Requesting quick executive approval to proceed with the following offering: 20% list discount, $35k one-time credit, and the following publicity terms — 1 co-branded case study (60-day turnaround), logo + testimonial usage across our website and sales decks for 12 months, and a limited exclusivity carveout scoped only to "anomaly-detection analytics" (not full analytics/BI).

Key asks to approvers:
- Approve narrow exclusivity (anomaly-detection only) for 9 months?
- Approve the 20% + $35k credit as concession tied to the marketing deliverables?
- Approve opt-out clause: either party can revoke logo use with 60 days notice, and Stratos can request removal of the case study copy after 12 months if legally required.

Attachments: Stratos_MOU_draft_v1.pdf (draft MOU).

Ben / Marissa — if we agree, can you confirm marketing deliverables and timing so I can push legal/procurement?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

From: Ava Roberts <ava@stratosanalytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@stratosanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Publicity in exchange for concession — ask for exec sign-off

Hi Rishi — appreciate the clear summary. We are willing to proceed on the commercial terms you outlined (20% + $35k credit) conditioned on the following publicity items:

- 9-month limited exclusivity specific to "anomaly-detection analytics" (we need that for our competitive positioning).
- A coordinated press release window: target Nov 1, 2027 (after our internal go-to-market event).
- Ability to request logo removal after 12 months for privacy/regulatory reasons.
- Procurement will issue a PO once a mutual MOU is signed and the exclusivity language is finalized.

Attaching a short procurement checklist (sent separately). I included procurement in cc so legal and purchasing can loop in their standard language. Let me know if you need any edits on the proposed visibility calendar.

Best,
Ava
VP, Strategic Partnerships
Stratos Analytics
ava@stratosanalytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Publicity in exchange for concession — ask for exec sign-off

Rishi — +1 on moving quickly. A few deal-desk considerations:

- We can approve up to 20% for this seat/term with a one-time credit (makes sense).
- Exclusivity is non-standard. I recommend we accept a narrowly scoped exclusivity but add a 60- to 90-day opt-out clause triggered by material product changes or competitive conflicts.
- Suggest we cap exclusivity scope, explicitly excluding platform-level features (so Stratos isn't blocking us from other analytics customers broadly).

If leadership signs off on the exclusivity carveout (anomaly-detection only) + 60-day opt-out, I will mark deal RDW-2027-3745 as approvable. I'll also include the price_terms_summary.csv for finance.

Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Publicity in exchange for concession — marketing deliverables + legal needs

Team — marketing can deliver the assets but need clear guardrails:

- Deliverables we will produce: 1 written case study (customer quote + outcomes), 1 co-authored blog, 3 social posts, and a short video testimonial (30-45s) if Stratos agrees.
- Timeline: draft case study in 45 days from signed MOU; final in 60 days. Press release timing depends on Stratos' event calendar (Nov 1 proposed — fine).
- Quote approval: Stratos must sign off on any direct quotes. Legal needs an explicit release for use of identifiable metrics.
- Exclusivity impact: If we accept limited exclusivity we need a clause that allows Redwood to use the assets in non-compete channels (e.g., product pages) after 12 months even if Stratos requests logo removal; otherwise we lose marketing value.

Attached: marketing_asset_checklist.xlsx.

If leadership is comfortable with the restricted exclusivity + 60-day opt-out and the commercial concession, we can commit to the deliverables.

— Marissa
Director, Marketing Programs
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Exec decision requested: Stratos visibility carveout + concession (RDW-2027-3745)

Vivek — need a short sign-off from execs on this commercial+marketing trade-off. Quick recap:
- Offer: 20% discount (1 year) + $35k one-time credit.
- In return: 1 case study, co-authored blog, social amplification (3 posts), and logo + quote usage.
- Stratos asks for 9-month limited exclusivity (anomaly-detection only).
- Proposed Redwood conditions: 60-day opt-out, exclusivity scoped narrowly to "anomaly-detection analytics" (explicitly exclude platform/BI customers), and marketing asset retention clause allowing Redwood to retain and use non-identifying assets after 12 months.

Attachments: Stratos_MOU_draft_v1.pdf; price_terms_summary.csv.

Approve "yes" to proceed on these terms (we will finalize MOU and loop legal/procurement). If no, please indicate what to push back on. Time sensitive — Stratos wants the mutual draft by Monday to hit procurement cycles.

Rishi

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec decision requested: Stratos visibility carveout + concession (RDW-2027-3745)

Yes — approved with conditions.

Conditions:
1) Exclusivity limited strictly to "anomaly-detection analytics" and terminates automatically after 9 months; add an explicit 60-day opt-out for either party.
2) Legal to approve final exclusivity language to ensure no platform/market-level restrictions.
3) Marketing deliverables limited to what Marissa specified. No additional financial concessions beyond the $35k credit; finance to confirm margin impact.
4) Procurement to add a clause allowing Redwood to continue to use anonymized, non-identifying metrics from the case study after 12 months if Stratos requests logo removal.

Once legal signs off on the language I authorize Ben to finalize. Rishi — move forward and get the mutual MOU in DocuSign.

— Vivek
CEO, Redwood Inference
viv e k_kulkarni@redwood.com
